status: PROPOSED (dry-run until the owner sets modes.json contract=v2, entries=LIVE)
alpha_source: world-digest typed implications through SHADOW_NEWS_v0's frozen news_signal (d > 0 only), fixed 1% of equity per name, <= 10 names, 5 sessions
why_this_account: hack6 keeps its ten tracker names under v1 terms; the free cash carries a small news sleeve so news is tested at small weight

costs.fill_convention: DAY limit at ask x (1+10bps) for buys and bid x (1-10bps) for sells; an unfilled limit is not traded; last trade when the IEX quote is one-sided or wider than 2%

objective: terminal wealth vs SPY and vs the frozen twin, graded daily; the question is whether this alpha source's errors differ from the other accounts'; no claim of skill
legacy: names held when v2 becomes active and not targeted by it keep their v1 terms (stop, horizon) and are not counted as capacity: v2 fills what remains of the gross cap

selection.rule: world_digest.news_signal over the newest digest's typed implications (horizon 5 or 20, ticker subjects, not refused; social-only implications never reach the digest's implication list): d_i = mean(sign x confidence). Long only: names with d_i > 0, strongest first, excluding bar-defect / stitched names and names that already moved > 2 five-session sigma; 1% of equity each, at most 10 names; held 5 sessions, then exited unless re-signalled
selection.llm_authority: none: only typed, validated fields reach this rule; no free text decides an order
selection.sources_refused: X / Reddit / StockTwits never originate an order (SOCIAL_ONLY is refused upstream)

twin.note: the sleeve's own random twin is drawn at entry with seed = hash(role, day)

stop_rule.sigma: 63-session sd of close-to-close returns on the bar-defect-screened panel (Alpaca daily bars when a name is not in the panel)
stop_rule.distance: clip(k_sigma x sigma, min_frac, max_frac) of the reference price
stop_rule.never_loosen: a replaced stop is never below the stop it replaces
stop_rule.order: GTC sell stop for the full long quantity; renewed within 7 days of its expiry

exits: 5 sessions unless re-signalled; resting stops; legacy names keep v1 terms
